provenance: Real output of the git commands the kernel 0.2.1 history-compatibility paths consume, captured 2026-09-23 with git 2.43.0 against the scratch repositories test/history-compat.test.ts stages. budget-name-list and budget-name-list-pulse are the name list classifyReviewBudget in src/gates/merge-preconditions.ts reads to decide that the change is dual-tier; charter-history is the path-limited log firstDeclarationCommit in src/checks.ts reads to date the review-families declaration and find its parent. Commit shas carry the staging time, so each is spelled by the name the staging gives its commit, <name>, and the test translates git's live output the same way before comparing; no other byte is rewritten. The charter-history line for the declaration commit names <unrelated>, the real parent, and not <history>, the previous commit that touched charter.yaml: that is the property the capture pins, because rewritten parents would put the 0.1.0-era verdicts after the declaration. JSON escapes NUL as \u0000, so this file is ASCII.

budget: the change under review: modify src/feature.ts
the reviews: add two documents under delivery/review/
charter-history: history: three 0.1.0-era pulse verdicts under delivery/review/
current: the current pair under delivery/review/
